profile.headline: Privacy-Preserving ML/AI @ Meta | ex-Intel | PhD in Cryptography
profile.summary:
I work on privacy-preserving machine learning (PPML) and state-of-the-art ML/AI at Meta. My broader interests lie at the intersection of machine learning, security, and privacy; designing systems that enable AI innovation while preserving user privacy.

Previously, I was a research scientist at Intel Labs, where I worked on fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) and lattice-based cryptography in the Security and Privacy Research group.

I completed my PhD in Cryptography at Seoul National University (SNU) in 2021, under the supervision of Professor Jung Hee Cheon. I also received my B.S. in Mathematical Sciences from SNU, graduating with Highest Honors in 2015.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop Empirical DP techniques within a privacy‑preserving machine learning (PPML) framework for feature‑level privacy quantification.
• Integrate state‑of‑the‑art ML models (e.g., LLMs, Sequential Learning) to optimize performance under privacy constraints in Ads ranking.

positions.title: Research Scientist
positions.description:
• Led the FHE algorithm and workload team at Intel Labs, focusing on HW-friendly HE ops including bootstrapping and various FHE workloads.
• Spearheaded security and privacy research initiatives, contributing to cutting-edge advancements in the field.
• Developed innovative FHE-based solutions for graph database search, vector similarity search, LLM transformer, etc.

honors.title: Best PhD Dissertation Award
honors.issuer: Issued by Seoul National University · Feb 2021

honors.title: Excellence Award at 5th Samsung DS Industry-Academy Cooperation Project Paper Award

projects.title: HERACLES: Fully Homomorphic Encryption HW accelerator
projects.description:
- Aims to design and develop an FHE hardware accelerator integrating novel architectural approaches, hardware, and software to dramatically reduce the processing overhead required to implement FHE calculations.
- Engaged in DARPA DPRIVE (Data Protection in Virtual Environments) program
- Technical Lead of the Algorithm & Workload team

projects.title: Lizard: Round1 Submission for NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardiation Process
projects.description:
Lizard is a Round1 Submission for NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardiation Process.
I am one of the main inventors of the Lizard scheme.

publications.title: Efficient Homomorphic Comparison Methods with Optimal Complexity
